From d5028f9f7d8de5c375c52b98976b6f310e73398f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Vladimir Davydov <vdavydov@parallels.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Sep 2015 14:59:20 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] vmscan: fix sane_reclaim helper for legacy memcg

The sane_reclaim() helper is supposed to return false for memcg reclaim
if the legacy hierarchy is used, because the latter lacks dirty
throttling mechanism, and so it did before it was accidentally broken by
commit 33398cf2f360c ("memcg: export struct mem_cgroup").  Fix it.

Fixes: 33398cf2f360c ("memcg: export struct mem_cgroup")
Signed-off-by: Vladimir Davydov <vdavydov@parallels.com>
Acked-by: Tejun Heo <tj@kernel.org>
Acked-by: Michal Hocko <mhocko@suse.com>
Cc: Johannes Weiner <hannes@cmpxchg.org>
Signed-off-by: Andrew Morton <akpm@linux-foundation.org>
Signed-off-by: Linus Torvalds <torvalds@linux-foundation.org>

diff --git a/mm/vmscan.c b/mm/vmscan.c
index 2d978b28a410..7f63a9381f71 100644
--- a/mm/vmscan.c
+++ b/mm/vmscan.c
@@ -175,7 +175,7 @@ static bool sane_reclaim(struct scan_control *sc)
 	if (!memcg)
 		return true;
 #ifdef CONFIG_CGROUP_WRITEBACK
-	if (memcg->css.cgroup)
+	if (cgroup_on_dfl(memcg->css.cgroup))
 		return true;
 #endif
 	return false;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `mm/vmscan.c`**
- The condition in the `sane_reclaim` function was modified. 
- The original line:
  ```c
  if (memcg->css.cgroup)
  ```
  was changed to:
  ```c
  if (cgroup_on_dfl(memcg->css.cgroup))
  ```
- This change ensures that the `sane_reclaim` function correctly returns false for memory cgroup (memcg) reclaim when the legacy hierarchy is used, which does not support dirty throttling.

### Relationships
- The modification in `mm/vmscan.c` addresses a bug introduced by a previous commit (identified as `33398cf2f360c`), which altered the behavior of the `sane_reclaim` function. The patch restores the intended functionality of the helper by checking if the memory cgroup is on the default cgroup hierarchy, thereby ensuring compatibility with legacy memory cgroup configurations.

The sane_reclaim() helper is supposed to return false for memcg reclaim

Fixes: 33398cf2f360c ("memcg: export struct mem_cgroup")
Signed-off-by: Vladimir Davydov <vdavydov@parallels.com>
Acked-by: Tejun Heo <tj@kernel.org>
Acked-by: Michal Hocko <mhocko@suse.com>
Cc: Johannes Weiner <hannes@cmpxchg.org>
Signed-off-by: Andrew Morton <akpm@linux-foundation.org>

```
Reason:
The change in the condition from checking if `memcg->css.cgroup` exists to checking if it is on the default cgroup hierarchy (`cgroup_on_dfl`) inadvertently altered the logic of the `sane_reclaim` function. This caused the function to incorrectly return true for legacy memory cgroup reclaim, which should have returned false due to the absence of a dirty throttling mechanism.

```
